props.name: palette
props.description: Ink colours: CSS colours or tokens, or `'accent'` for four inks mixed from the accent and the ink token.

props.name: dropSize
props.description: Controlled drop radius, as a fraction of the paper’s height.

props.name: onDropSizeChange
props.description: Called when the drop-size slider moves.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Controlled pattern. Changing it empties the bath and makes the new pattern from its recipe.

props.name: onPatternChange
props.description: Called when the pattern control changes.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Play the recipe step by step when the paper first scrolls into view. Off, the finished pattern is shown at once.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the recipe where it is. Clicks and drags still work.

props.name: speed
props.description: Recipe playback speed. 1 makes a bouquet in about ten seconds.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Width over height of the paper.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the recipe, ink, size and edit controls.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. The canvas is described with the pattern and its operations; without a label it is decorative.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when a recipe starts playing and when it ends or is stopped.
